# DEC-NN <Topic> - Decision record

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Open, To confirm, Agreed in principle, Decided or Superseded |
| Decided by | user (date), or "not decided" |
| Owner | game-designer (writes the record; the user decides) |
| Last updated | YYYY-MM-DD |
| Related | Review items (C, D, N, G), tickets (TNN), other decisions |

**Summary.** The question and the current answer, in two sentences.

## Question
What must be decided, and why it matters.

## Decision
The user's decision in their own terms, with the date. "Not decided" when open.

## Still open
Parameters or sub-questions left to settle.

## Options considered

| Option | Principle | Benefits | Risks |
|---|---|---|---|

## Recommendation
The owner's recommendation and the pillars it serves. Kept for the record once decided.

## Parameters
Names to expose in data, with initial values or TODO.

## Playtest question
One question a playtest must answer.

## Impact
Tickets, documents and assets affected.
